newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Employee strike shuts down Sri Lanka universities.
newsitem.headline: Employee strike shuts down Sri Lanka universities.

text.p: Sri Lankan universities remained closed on Tuesday following a strike launched last weekend by non-academic staff demanding a salary increase.
"All universities are closed and students have been asked to vacate the campuses," a professor at the Kelaniya University in suburban Colombo told Reuters.
Examinations for many of the country's more than 32,000 undergraduate and graduate students were postponed, other university officials said.
Some 10,000 non-academic staff of 10 universitites were on strike demanding a 30 percent hike in salary, a trade union official said.
"We are prepared to continue with strike action if our demands are not met," said Ranjith Ananda of the Inter University Trade Union Federation.
Sri Lanka has 11 universities, all of them state-run.
